activity_summary: You went out to the bench at midday and read two speeches you had already written, and you did not touch them. The girl at the window stayed as she was on Saturday night. You put the stone back.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read what was already there, and put the stone back.

entities.name: the orchard scene
entities.context: Mentioned in The sheet he will not touch

facets.activity: Read two speeches under the stone
